checks.name: unit
checks.detail: `.venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/ -q` -> 53 passed, 0 failed, 0 skipped (23 prior + 30 new: 27 loader + 3 models). Re-run independently by main.

checks.name: red_green_discipline
checks.detail: RED confirmed: 27 loader tests failed with ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'app.loader' before implementation. GREEN after.

checks.name: a10_fold_identity_guard_real
checks.detail: app.loader.fold is app.text.fold -> True (verified independently by main). DISCRIMINATION PROVEN: subagent replaced the import with a local str.maketrans fold copy -> identity test FAILED, while `grep -rnE unicodedata app/loader.py` reported CLEAN in the same broken state. That contrast is exactly why plan.md rewrote A10 away from the grep (VL-16). The real guard now exists and works.

checks.name: a12_dataset_integrity
checks.detail: sha256(data/products.json) = 52355b43b3cf3ed51526efd31c828869f0f3eaf8f8edf268d815253917749043, unchanged before and after the full loader suite (verified independently by main). DISCRIMINATION PROVEN ON A COPY, NOT THE REAL FILE (deliberate: the dataset is the project's only data source and a mid-run interruption could corrupt it): mutating a tmp copy via p.write_text() changed mtime, size and sha256 -> the three-way comparison detects it, while the OLD grep for open(...,'w') misses write_text entirely.

checks.name: rk9_envelope_shape
checks.detail: load_dataset() reads d['products'] (20) and d['categories'] (5) from the dict envelope. test_load_dataset_raises_on_toplevel_list locks the list-vs-dict trap directly.

checks.name: rk8_total_key_collision
checks.detail: hasattr(Dataset, 'total') -> False (verified by main). The dataset's own total=20 key cannot leak into the pagination envelope's total.

checks.name: rk18_category_input_folding
checks.detail: resolve_category 7/7 correct. Main independently confirmed 3 cases (Tu Lanh, TU LANH, May in) return None under a direct category_map.get(value) lookup and only pass because resolve_category folds the INPUT -- the exact 3/7 failure VL-18 predicted.

checks.name: rk13_fail_fast
checks.detail: 6/6 corruption cases raise DatasetError, independently re-run by main: missing file, invalid JSON, top-level list, missing products key, empty products, duplicate ids. No silent return, no bare except.

checks.name: vl23_dead_fallback_branch
checks.detail: Main confirmed 0 real products are in the state (effective_price null AND original_price present), so the fallback branch is unreachable on real data. test_effective_price_falls_back_to_original correctly uses a synthetic dict and documents why.

checks.name: models_contract
checks.detail: PaginationEnvelope.model_fields == {total,page,page_size,items} exactly. ProductOut has 13 fields with zero leakage of availability/image_url/specifications/product_id_web/model_code. ProductOut.model_validate clean on 20/20 real products including printer-318469 with null prices.

checks.name: a11_pure_layer_no_http
checks.detail: grep -rnE 'fastapi|starlette' app/loader.py app/models.py -> 0 lines. CAVEAT recorded: the subagent had to reword a models.py docstring that mentioned those names in PROSE to clear this grep. A11's grep matches prose and would miss an importlib-based import -- it is a weaker criterion than it appears. Not blocking; logged for the final review.
